page.layout: One column of running text; marginal numerals in the right margin; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: a Omnium minimè autem pontificis Romani.
Adhæc examinato præcipua doctrinæ Christianæ loca: & demonstra quàm indignè s. literarum auctoritatem suis decretis & traditionibus postponant, ac Dei legem ac euangelium violent.III.
Exempli gratia: quòd {4}Traditiones & consensum conciliorum atque ecclesiæ Romanæ, vel decreta pontificum suorum scripturis proprie canonicis adæquant, ne dicam, præferunt.V.
b Pontifex etiam sibi vendicat potestatem relaxandi leges Dei immutabiles, & conscientias hominum ab earum observatione pronunciandi liberas.II. [?]
c Similiter de iuramentis iustis & legitimis dispensant, & subditos sacramento solvunt.
d Præterea Papam à nemine mortalium judicari volunt, licet innumerabiles populos cervatim secum detrudat in gehennam.e

page.notes: Marginal numerals in the right margin read as III., VI, V, IIII and II [?]; their exact vertical alignment with the lines is approximate. The reference mark "4" after "quòd" is small and may be a footnote mark; read as 4 [?]. Section letters a–e at paragraph starts are italic and printed inside the column; the letter "e" at the foot stands beside the catchword "Ad-". "cervatim" is read as printed "caterva-tim" with a line-end hyphen; the word is rendered as caterva-tim in the scan and was joined here. Long s in "s. literarum" is read as the abbreviation for sacrarum. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.
